items.title: Family Funday with Babyfit Academy at Amarai beach
items.description:
A vibrant family event hosted by BabyFit, bringing families together for a full day of fun, creativity, movement, and connection.

Cute Kids Academy brought the little ones a variety of hands-on crafts and creative activities, including drawing and creating with shells, while keeping toddlers engaged with age-appropriate games and challenges. 🎨🐚

From creative corners to family challenges and playful moments by the beach, the event was all about creating quality family time and memories that last beyond the day. 💛🌊✨

items.title: School Me Event 2024
items.description:
School Me is an annual educational event designed to help parents make one of the most important decisions for their children: choosing the right school.

The event brings together a wide range of schools and educational institutions, giving parents the opportunity to explore different education systems, compare options, and discover what best suits their child’s needs, personality, and future goals.

At School Me, we’re here to make the school-selection journey easier, clearer, and more informed — helping every family find the right educational path for their child.
